bug_info.bug_desc: In the pre-merge code, spi_fwm_rxf_ctrl handled a partial word after the wait timer expired by performing an SRAM read-modify-write. It transitioned from StWait to StRead, asserted a read request, waited in StModify for sram_rvalid, and only then issued a write while merging sram_rdata into the disabled byte lanes of sram_wdata. This violates the receive-path requirement to perform writes only, and when byte-by-byte transfers forced the partial-write path, the extra read request produced the arbiter data-flow assertion observed in the PR. The design also forced FwModeRxFifo's SRAM write mask to all 1s, so the partial-word write could not simply be emitted without a read: the RXF controller had no write-mask output and spi_fwmode did not wire one through.
bug_info.fix_hint: Eliminate the RMW FSM path. Remove StRead/StModify and the sram_wdata_sel merging logic; on timer expiry in StWait go directly to StWrite with a write request. Add an sram_wmask output driven from byte_enable via sram_strb2mask, with all-ones for full-word writes, connect it from u_rxf_ctrl in spi_fwmode, and delete the force of fwm_sram_wmask[FwModeRxFifo] to '1 so the arbiter receives the correct write strobes.
